items.description: Generates a profile image for your unique Facebook ID. Can be posted to the Wall and Profile page. Shows how all your friends look like as Retro Avatar.

NZ Topo Map is an interactive topographic map of New Zealand using the official LINZ's 1:50,000 / Topo50 and 1:250,000 / Topo250 maps. Stewart Island and the Chatham Islands are also covered. Search and locate any landscape feature on the map: towns, streams, caves, glaciers, forests, huts, mountains and more. Share or bookmark results for later use.

At Sea Scotia Vacation Rentals we want you to have the Nova Scotia Vacation of a lifetime. We have some of the finest Nova Scotia Cottages and Nova Scotia Vacation rentals. All locations are listed on the map.
Nationwide map listing thousands of garage sales pulled from Craigslist and its own users. All sales take place within the next two weeks.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.
See casinos and other places to legally play live poker on a map. Find the closest rooms sorted by distance, get driving directions and the casino web site.
We all have people in our lives we'd like to talk to more often. Stay In Touch is a simple app that helps you prioritize and stay connected to the family and friends you care about.
Search, compare and buy robes on French shopping websites. Uses the Shopping.com API.
Ransomizr creates a randomly generated font from single-letter Flickr images and allows you to immediately compose and save ransom-letter-style notes.
Create a photomosaic out of thousands of flickr images.

Last Call is a free, easy way to estimate your blood-alcohol level and determine if it's safe for you to drive after drinking. If not, use it to call a cab. Last Call also provides a list of top local DUI lawyers, provided by Avvo, to call for help if you need it.

The site resolves short url's used on sites like twitter. The results show information on the page and the domain the page is on. The perfect tool for checking a short url if you are not sure about it.
Collaborative urban resource mapping.
Interactive Map of golf courses worldwide. Golf Course Directory with satellite images and photos.
Using Google Maps API plus Google KML API to render my blog in a Geo context.
Frtr (pronounced fritter) allows you to easily record then tweet a video recorded with your webcam.
Links you to pizzeria reviews at America’s Favorite Pizza Weblog. With fun slice-shaped map markers.
Search service for real estate or apartments to rent in Singapore.

AIMcrm offers a combination of web analytics, sales force automation and customer relationship management software in a single app. Added telephony integration that allows new leads to be marketed to proactively and tracked accurately using the Twilio API.
Keep up with the lastest UFO sightings with this combination of Google Maps and data from the National UFO Reporting Center.
A web map that lets users simply find ownership and tax information as well as their nearest parks, libraries, fire stations, walkability, etc.
